{{Quote|We lost the whole comm center, more or less intact, and most of the sector fleet supply depots.|[[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]], to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
The '''Atrivis Sector Force''' was the name given to the [[Atrivis Resistance Group/Legends|Atrivis Resistance Group]] after it joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The unit was placed under the command of the Alliance [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Sector Command]], as the renaming made the unit an officially recognized [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]].

It was later reorganized as a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]]. Most of the fleet supply depots were located on [[Generis/Legends|Generis]]. They were [[Fall of Generis|lost]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TLC" />
